text: Computer vision is a field of artificial intelligence that teaches computers to understand images and videos. It combines image recognition, which identifies what is in a picture, with object detection, which finds and locates specific items, such as people, animals, or even traffic signs. This technology is used everywhere today: from unlocking your phone with your face to sorting photos on your social media. One of its most exciting applications is in self-driving cars. These vehicles use cameras and computer vision to detect pedestrians, other cars, and road markings instantly. By processing visual data in real time, the system helps the car make safe decisions, making the dream of hands-free driving closer to reality every day.
